notes.title: Multiple changes and fixes!
notes.notes:
[p]I've pushed a patch to live with the following changes:[/p][p]-Gaining max charges now grant a charge along with it.
-Should no longer be able to get stuck in the corners on any stages.
-Pausing no longer destroys summons for Goblineer and Reanimator.
-Pausing now also pauses bosses from spawning enemies.
-Pyromaniac no longer takes damage from any fires, and all fires should apply his on fire buff.
-Cosmic crystals that spawn for the feed the crystal mission should no longer be able to be pushed outside of the stage, becoming unfindable.
-Patrol missions will now be discarded upon returning to Hall of Heroes when dying or returning from the pause menu.
-Patrol missions can now be swapped by simply using the console again after picking up a patrol mission.
-Slightly lowered the chance for normal enemy voice taunts to trigger.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Fangs changes plus a few other fixes.
notes.notes:
Pushing one final update for the day with the following changes:

- Fangs now auto activates his running swiping attack anytime he moves and also moves normally instead of constantly moving towards the cursor.
- Fangs bats will now circle around the cursor instead of him, allowing players a little more control over where the bats are.
- Fixed an issue where unplugging a controller while playing could cause portions of the pause screen to move off screen.
- Fixed an issue with controller that could cause attacking to flicker between attacking and not attacking.
- Lowered the chance for the projectiles spawning on building hit modifier and slightly lowered the amount spawned.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.notes:
I've pushed another small patch through, with the following changes:
- Increased Patrol Mission reward.
- Substantially increased reward for defeating the boss of a stage.
- Fixed issue where the boss of the 5th stage could dash through objects.

notes.title: First Post Release Update/New Character Preview
notes.notes: [p]Greetings![/p][h3][b]First Update[/b][/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/accf7d258e25ce24de2e4775301cb134b4a73519.png"][/img][/h3][p]A lot of you seem to be enjoying Heroes Unhinged, which is great to hear!  We are committed to improving where we can and our first review brought up a good point about permanent progression.  In response to this we have released an update today changing how the bonus points machine works.  It will now provide bonus points in the same way as before, but instead of lasting for just one stage, they will be permanent and apply randomly every time you enter any stage.  These bonus points will also be saved.  To compensate for this, prices for the points now start low and scale up high.  The max number of bonus points has been raised from 50 to 100.  We are throwing around ideas for other ways to provide permanent progression![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Character Preview[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/4fe989395e435067478a804cfce97669d632028a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We also want to give a preview of one of our first characters we're preparing for our first big update.  This new character is The Annihilator!  He wields a sawed-off shotgun and prefers to be close range.  His ability dashes in the direction the player is aiming, stopping at the first enemy he collides with, grabbing them and ripping them apart giving him a small heal, and a buff that provides movement speed and damage.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Heroes Unhinged Available Now!
notes.notes: [p]Greetings![/p][p]Heroes Unhinged is now available!  We hope you enjoy the variety of stages and heroes we have!  Thank you everyone for your support, we can't wait to show you more with our first update![/p]

notes.title: Small Update for Demo and Full Version
notes.notes: [p]Greetings![/p][p]We've pushed a small update to both the demo and full version with the following changes:[/p][p][/p][p]Both Versions[/p][list][*][p]Increased text size on multiple UI elements to make it more readable on handheld screens.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Full Version[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue that could cause the game to crash when using Storm Guy's ability after completing a stage.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Next Fest!
notes.notes: [p]Next Fest has started, and Heroes Unhinged is there!  We've been updating consistently up to this point, so often that we decided to hold off patch notes for every little change.  The demo and full version are both now updated to the same point, and we feel like we have a stable base to build upon!  We are going to begin work on our first update, which will add more of everything!  Stages, Heroes, modifiers, cosmic powers, we plan to expand in all these areas!  I also very much want to hear any feedback, suggestions, or anything you might like to see, so feel free to post here and I'll answer as soon as I can![/p]

notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.notes:
-Fixed an issue that could cause saved progress to reset.
-Fix for controller stat power point selection sometimes disappearing.

notes.title: The Watcher's Services
notes.notes:
Greetings!
Today I'll be sharing a bit about a mysterious figure you'll come across called the watcher.  At any point during a stage he may appear, bringing gifts and services.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/f5bbb27e81306848aeb3d07eb92b071655777b64.png[/img]

Along with giving you cosmic powers, he also sells some crystals that increase your stats.  If you approach him while having any cosmic powers, he'll offer to replace or upgrade any powers you have, for a fee of course!

notes.title: Will Demo Progress Carry Over?
notes.notes:
Greetings!
We are happy to announce that any progress made in the demo will carry over to the full game, this includes all fragments stored, all statistics, and cosmic colors!  So, enjoy and collect those fragments and you'll be ready to use new features, unlock characters, and unlock stages in the full release!  To make sure progress carries over smoothly, simply launch Heroes Unhinged while a demo save is present.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!
A small update has been deployed, here's the changes!

-scaling of enemy damage has been lowered.
-scaling of enemy and structure health has been lowered.
-structure starting health increased.
-enemy projectiles now move at a slower speed.
-few graphics issues fixed.

notes.title: Demo Cosmic Power Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!
We've updated the demo to use our current cosmic power system from the full game.  The old system allowed any damage to trigger cosmic powers while the new system only allows cosmic powers to trigger on heroes' attacks and abilities.  This update also reworks the cosmic burst power, giving it new functionality!

notes.title: Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
-Fixed issue preventing trees and walls from counting towards destruction.
-Number of crystal runners required for patrol mission lowered.

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!
A small update has been applied to the demo build!  This update has small changes to spawn amount related to destruction, along with putting in place progress conversion to the full game upon release.  Any progress made in the demo will be transferred to the full version as long as a demo save is present when you first load into the full version!  Thanks!

notes.title: Heroes Unhinged Demo Available Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings!

The Heroes Unhinged demo is now available to download!  This demo consists of 4 playable heroes, 2 stages, and a handful of modifiers, missions, and cosmic powers.

notes.title: Hall of Heroes
notes.notes:
Greetings!  Today I'm going to give a little information about what happens in between stages.  After completing a mission or destroying an entire stage a portal will open up that allows the heroes to return to the Hall of Heroes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/c8a05ac79f215e268f052a1ec60c889eee3761b7.png[/img]

The first thing a hero should do on returning is deposit the fragments they collected so they can't be lost.
Heroes can use these fragments for many things.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/703729ee436be5123523f08bed14811fcda26b75.png[/img]

Fragments might be spent to open portals leading to new stages!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/834efd054a19ae348b09883afdbff62a73a044a2.png[/img]

Patrol missions will assign you a random objective to complete on any stage you currently have unlocked.  These are optional but will lead to increased rewards if completed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/2175951057c8fc9eb1ae4b0fe6910d4800ddba55.png[/img]

Maybe the hero wants to have their cosmic powers match them a little better.  The cosmic color randomizer will help you get the colors you want, for fragments of course!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/593172cb617838b55b64334f8d38c601a3aa9890.png[/img]

Maybe you want a little boost to your power on the next stage.  Temporary enhancements allow a hero to start the next stage with increased power.  Very useful when increasing tiers on a stage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/4db2bbe448998deb215302142addd536d34cfda5.png[/img]

Finally the hero can beef up the next stage they do, increasing rewards while also increasing difficulty.  The current max tier is 50 which will add up to 5 random modifiers and x6 fragment drops!

notes.title: Dr. Plague Abilities Overview
notes.notes:
Greetings!  Today we will be showing off Dr. Plague.  She throws vials of acid and infects enemies with a contagious plague from her syringe tip gloves.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/0d05b289712a5f3b7d01b48ffb0ba21c26320bab.png[/img]

Dr. Plague's basic attack throws a vial that explodes into a puddle of acid.  She is limited to having 3 active acid puddles at a time.  These acid puddles will constantly damage anything they touch and slow enemies that are walking through it.  Dr. Plague gets a slight movement speed buff while running through the acid puddles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/5669143a155d6af0e53019dc69493babdded2224.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/eaa1ec94bde991bd9863b4b68b3b635bb7a255a7.png[/img]

Dr. Plague's special ability is infecting enemies with a contagious plague.  She will infect any enemies directly in front of her when her ability is used.  Infected enemies will take continuous damage as long as they are alive, and when they succumb to the infection they will explode, doing damage and infecting other nearby enemies.

Until next time!

notes.title: Fangs Abilities Overview
notes.notes:
Today we're going to show you Fangs.  This vampire hero will charge through crowds of enemies while summoning bats to fly around him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/e17d128f911b91ddeafa47ba5bc2a4e5c5229cb0.png[/img]

Fangs' basic attack is a running claw swipe that has small knockback.  While holding the basic attack button down he will continually run towards where the player is aiming.  While running he can charge through buildings, damaging them constantly at the cost of health.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/51a3c621372ba15932bc072abc9b8072c2e947d6.png[/img]

Fangs' special ability is completely passive and doesn't require any activation.  As long as there is a charge available Fangs will automatically summon bats that fly around him randomly.  These bats will heal Fangs when they do damage to any enemy.

See you next time!

notes.title: Poof Abilities Overview
notes.notes:
Greetings!  Today we will give a short description on Poof and his abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/31e14ba765b2c432f3946f354da099eaec5a06b5.png[/img]

Poof uses bladed claws to attack quickly within melee range.  This attack is quick and has a slight knockback to keep those in front of you crowd controlled.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/964f6bf59da771c447690c35e2823d83062bce05.png[/img]

Poof's special ability puts him into a state of teleporting rage.  Each ability charge allows him to remain in this state for two seconds.  While in this state poof gains movement speed and also teleports randomly all around hitting random enemies.  While attacking in this state, the random teleports will ramp up, hitting more enemies more quickly.

Until next time!

notes.title: Soldier Dude Abilities Overview
notes.notes:
Today we're showing you Soldier Dude!  He's all about huge area effect explosions with mines that allow him to easily control an area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/7147770d6acd821ea248fffe252664a44b9b9965.png[/img]

Soldier Dude's basic attack is shooting his assault rifle.  This attack has very little knockback but will pierce enemies in a line!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/09984f908421f6dc7d8806407b0a6ffd4c593162.png[/img]

The special ability Soldier Dude has is his mines.  He will place 4 mines at a time around himself that arm instantly and blow up on the first enemy to come into range.  The explosion from these mines is very large and will hit everything in the area and also comes with a massive knockback.  This combination allows Soldier Dude to easily hold areas with tons of mines placed.

See you soon for another hero preview!

notes.title: The Rat Abilities Overview
notes.notes:
Our second ability breakdown is for The Rat.  This character relies on keeping enemies at bay while maintaining sharp blades thrown out that then return!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/ff2d17f5f4aef137eea079e102d91d76deffae7c.png[/img]

The Rat's basic attack is using his staff to smack enemies.  This attack has a small knockback allowing him to keep enemies in front of him from attacking him.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/abd756d7e875a97eb15e5636b0f8bb2572663a7b.png[/img]

The Rat's special ability throws out 3 blades that pierce through all enemies hit.  The blades will return towards The Rat after a short duration.  If The Rat is attacking when the blades reach him, he will heal a small amount and send the blades back out in a random direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/8bb0e2bee2812950e4ee337ddb144e58ec135bf3.png[/img]

Our next breakdown will be for Soldier Dude!

notes.title: Guyman Abilities Overview
notes.notes:
Welcome!  Heroes Unhinged is a game where the player chooses the hero they want and are set loose to destroy criminal infested areas.  The goal is to destroy all major structures while an ever-increasing number of enemies try to stop you.  Players will find crystals that give stat bonuses, fragments used to purchase bonuses, and power points which can be placed in any stat, to become powerful over the course of a stage.  We're going to start a series of posts detailing the different playable characters in Heroes Unhinged.  First up is Guyman!

Guyman is a flying hero which in Heroes Unhinged means he can maintain movement while attacking.  His basic attack is a slow but powerful punch with a large knockback.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/e250c908a083249c4947021d0b210a23a6fe11ba.png[/img]

Guyman's special ability is channeling a beam from his eyes.  This beam will do constant damage and small pushback to anything in its path.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45534685/39b57b403f237b33e9d0582415db029dc0ca7581.png[/img]

Guyman's eye beam can apply constant pressure to an area, meaning players might focus less on damage and more on max ability charges and charge gain so that it is always available to use!
